suite: V2.15 navigation, modal and keyboard continuity
runtime: Actual source with controlled DOM/browser shells

results.name: A completed modal save returns to the same record control after its workspace is rebuilt
Removed or ambiguous controls fall back to the page heading; another actor never inherits the focus target
A continuation dialog retains the original workspace return target
Escape uses the same close lifecycle and retains dirty entries until discard
Back-style navigation cannot replace source context while an asynchronous modal save is in flight
Returning to an original no-hash entry protects dirty edits and uses its default route only after discard
Search starts upward at the last result, downward at the first, and leaves IME composition alone
Route changes focus the new page without changing its remembered scroll or taking focus from an explicit workflow
An inline render restores the unique original field and a stale deferred render never steals focus
Correction deep links focus again after revisiting and ignore callbacks for a route already left
